'''Crimson fungus''' is a secret [[ingredient]] from [[Hell]] whose [[intrinsic]] is {{EffectLink|Weakness}}. Picking it up only unlocks a recipe for 2 red dye; its foods never appear in the recipe book.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/recipe_unlocks/crimson_fungus.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==

=== Secret ingredient ===
{{Spoiler}}
Crimson Fungus is cooked like a mushroom: braised into [[braised crimson fungus]] (Weakness, 0:30), pickled with a brown mushroom into [[pickled crimson fungus]] (a splash potion of Weakness II for 1 minute) and cooked with steak, dough and milk into [[crimson stroganoff]] (Weakness, 5:00). Cooking it grants the advancement ''Hidden Flavors''. See [[Secret recipes]].
